tools.name: understand_need
tools.description: Private, read-only coordination. Converts the person's own description into a nonclinical coordination frame, routes explicit emergency/crisis/withdrawal/safeguarding signals to qualified humans, and never diagnoses, treats, prescribes, or creates an employer-facing health record.

tools.name: next_action
tools.description: Private, read-only prioritization over caller-supplied CareWork. Qualified-human routes outrank routine work; blocked work outranks creating more work. Returns one next action and no clinical interpretation.

tools.name: prepare_visit
tools.description: Private, read-only visit preparation. Organizes the person's reason, facts, records and questions without turning them into diagnoses or treatment recommendations. The clinician's actual instructions remain authoritative.

tools.name: track_followup
tools.description: Private, read-only follow-up tracking. Keeps appointments, referrals, records and other stated next steps from disappearing. It records what another person or service said should happen; it does not invent clinical next steps.

tools.name: capacity_checkin
tools.description: Private, read-only capacity check-in. Keeps private blockers private and emits only coarse available/reduced/unavailable for a shared work graph. It is never fitness-for-duty and never exposes health reasons to an employer or public board.

tools.name: credential_quote
tools.description: Price and preview a Vealth credential certificate BEFORE paying for one. tools.name: gmx_get_orders
tools.description: Read all pending orders (limit, stop-loss, etc.) for a wallet on GMX v2 (Arbitrum). Read-only, no signing needed, free.

tools.name: gmx_get_prices
tools.description: Fetch current mark prices for all tradeable assets on GMX v2 (Arbitrum). Read-only, no signing needed, free.

tools.name: prepare_gmx_order
tools.description: Build an unsigned on-chain transaction to open a new perpetual position on GMX v2 (Arbitrum). Returns transaction fields ready for the caller to sign with their own wallet. tools.name: submit_gmx_order
tools.description: Relay a signed Ethereum transaction to the Arbitrum network. The transaction must have been pre-signed by the caller using prepare_gmx_order output. This endpoint does NOT sign — it only broadcasts an already-signed transaction.
